summary: Bounds-checked index accessor. Reads an index (dword_8AC38C), its upper bound (dword_8AC390), and a base pointer (dword_8AC394). If the index is out of range (index >= bound or index < 0) returns 0; otherwise returns base + 1060 * index, i.e. a pointer to array element [index] in an array of 1060-byte stride.

operations.description: Bounds guard: return 0 when index dword_8AC38C is >= upper bound dword_8AC390 or negative.
Compute element offset 1060 * dword_8AC38C (array stride 1060 bytes).
Add the computed offset to base dword_8AC394 to form the element address.
Return base dword_8AC394 + 1060 * index for a valid index.

unresolved: The referenced array has 1060-byte stride, not the known vehicle-struct stride, so the element type here is unconfirmed.
Semantic meaning of the three globals (index, bound, base) beyond their mechanical roles is not in the packet.
Which object owns the globals is unknown; owner kept UNKNOWN.
